exposure: Elective induction of labor at 39 weeks
cohort: 1234 low-risk nulliparous women who fulfilled the ARRIVE trial criteria and were managed expectantly at an Italian referral academic hospital
finding: In the cohort study, expectant management in low-risk pregnancies with late preterm screening of feto-maternal well-being seemed to achieve better maternal and perinatal outcomes than a universal policy of induction at 39 weeks.
